newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Merrills sets A$100 mln fungible kangaroo bond.
newsitem.headline: Merrills sets A$100 mln fungible kangaroo bond.

text.p: Merrill and Co Inc said on Wednesday it is issuing A$100 million of March 2002 kangaroo bonds which will be fungible with the original A$200 million offering made in April.
Pricing of the issue, which carry a coupon of 7.625 percent, will be on Thursday and settlement will be July 23.
The original offering, rated AA minus and Aa3, was priced at 40 basis points over the March 2002 government bond.
Merrill Lynch reported second quarter net earnings of US$481 million on Tuesday, the highest of any quarter in the firm's history.
